title: Staple Hop
generation_prompt: Original all-ages liquid drum-and-bass instrumental for a beginner-friendly one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game at a STRICT constant 168 BPM in 4/4 for 128 seconds. START AT FULL GROOVE at t=0 with no intro: the very first bar must have a loud, dry kick and snare at the SAME final-mix level as the middle of the track, plus distinct midrange key attacks. Never use an eight-second quiet buildup, ramp, filtered beat or near-silent opening. From the FIRST SECOND to the last bar keep an audible quantized two-step grid: short punchy kick on beats one and three, dry strong snare on beats two and four, crisp closed eighth-note hats with occasional quiet sixteenth-note skips, and at least eight separate short midrange pitched or muted-key attacks in every two-bar phrase including the first 16 seconds and the quieter middle. Never fade or filter away the beat; no ambient intro, drum dropout, half-time breakdown, free-time passage, tempo drift or long smeared reverb hiding attacks. Signature hook: two warm clipped synth tones hop up by a fifth, a third bright glass-key note lands one eighth-note early, then a lower rounded bass-key answer drops after the snare. Keep the pitched hook above a nimble sub bass and small warm chord fragments, with ghost snares adding movement without overpowering the main backbeat. At the midpoint preserve the SAME uninterrupted two-step grid, start the phrase with the low answer, change the order of the two rising synth tones and give the glass-key anticipator a higher register; the final quarter adds a short syncopated counterline and a fresh cadence instead of repeating the opening. One evolving 128-second stereo instrumental, fast but welcoming, with clean attacks, controlled highs and no harsh distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.
cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original duohertz album cover for Staple Hop, an all-ages drum-and-bass rhythm-game track. Original high-contrast editorial comic-print collage on near-black ink. Main motif: exactly TWO huge warm-ivory U-shaped BENT PAPER STAPLES, tilted at different angles and clearly separated, one higher and one lower, with a small electric-cyan square hopping through the air between their open ends. Add a short coral paper shadow behind the lower staple to suggest a syncopated landing. Broad simple silhouettes, tactile cut edges, sparse halftone and quiet dark space in the lower fifth for a local title overlay. The staples are abstract folded paper marks, not a metal office product or a doorway. Readable at 100px. No rail, road, ladder, window, door, building, circles, rings, lightning bolt, people, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Staple Hop square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card.
